note: Attacker-controlled TGA bytes are placed into a QBuffer that will be read by the TGA handler.
The 18-byte TGA header is parsed from the input: image_type=10 (RLE_RGB), width=1, height=1, pixel_size=24, flags=0x20.
Header passes IsSupported, so LoadTGA is invoked with the RLE_RGB image type.
size = 1*1*3 = 3 bytes; image buffer of 3 bytes is malloc'd.
RLE packet header byte 0x80 is read: high bit set means RLE packet, count = (0x80 & 0x7f)+1 = 1.
readRawData is called to read 3 pixel bytes, but the file ends after the packet header; the return value is not checked, so pixel[] remains uninitialized.
Uninitialized pixel bytes are copied into the image buffer.
The uninitialized bytes from the image buffer are read to compute the pixel color, a use-of-uninitialized-value detected by MSAN.
